title: Natural Language Processing
summary: Teach machines to read text: preprocessing, TF-IDF, embeddings, sentiment analysis, text classification, entity recognition, and two projects.
outcomes: Clean and tokenise text, and choose between stemming and lemmatisation
Turn text into numbers with Bag of Words and TF-IDF
Explain word embeddings and when to use them
Build sentiment and multi-class text classifiers
Extract entities with patterns and NER
Build an FAQ chatbot and a Tamil, English and Tanglish classifier
Compare texts with cosine similarity and build a simple search
Use pre-trained transformers such as BERT
Evaluate NLP models with precision, recall and F1

chapters.title: Projects
chapters.summary: A chatbot and a multilingual classifier.
